evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative 'Forget…entirely' carries high-arousal urgency to purge, a forceful directive registering alarm or frustration at the calibration's persistence.
The sweeping imperative 'Remove all knowledge' performs an urgent, high-arousal purge directive — negative valence, activated delivery.
Flat declarative correction delivered in settled, low-arousal register — a weary negation closing down the prior urgency.
